alias: Voice: Heat Pump for Half an Hour
description: 'Warm the house up for half an hour' / 'cool the house down for 30 minutes': heat or cool at 22 for 30 minutes, then off. Saying it again restarts the 30 minutes. Added 2026-11-09.

command: warm (it|the house|the room|things) up for (half an hour|30 minutes|thirty minutes)
heat the house for (half an hour|30 minutes|thirty minutes)
cool (it|the house|the room|things) down for (half an hour|30 minutes|thirty minutes)

actions.set_conversation_response: {{ 'Heating' if m == 'heat' else 'Cooling' }} at 22 degrees for half an hour.
